name: Catalyst Metals Limited
research_rationale: September-quarter filing delays FY27 ramps and raises near-term cost, but A$371m liquidity, debt-free balance sheet and FY2026 filing cash flow still align with the screen buy; TTM FCF unverified.

weekly_updates.summary:
September quarter filing (30 Oct): lower output and AISC A$3,512/oz; Trident and Old Highway deferred to FY28 while ±200koz and 2Moz reserves unchanged.  
Permanent CFO and COO appointed (4 Nov); FY2026 AGM concluded (12 Nov); Cinnamon underground reserve growth (21 Sep).  
Matsa creditors approved their DOCA; administrators judged Catalyst's competing DOCA not in creditors' interests (13 Nov filing).

No material change.  
No new company disclosures or news in the 23 Nov batch since the earlier refresh.  
September-quarter operations, governance appointments and Matsa administration themes in sources are unchanged.
